name: API key app
description: Connect an API using a key from your provider.

methods.whenToUse: Use credentials from your provider account.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a restricted API key and paste it here.

credentialFields.label: API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Actions depend on the operator-supplied API and key; grant read/write on the required resources at the provider. Create a key with read and write permissions for these actions; Paperclip cannot increase an existing key’s permissions.
